City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  August 18, 2025

  The Claims Review Committee met in the Finance Department Conference Room, 1st Floor, at
  10:30 a.m.

  Members Present:  Bianca Plascencia, Finance Department
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk
  Derald Brenneman, Legal

  Staff Present:  Derald Brenneman –Legal

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of the July 07, 2025, meeting were approved as recorded.

  2. City of Inglewood - The recommended Resolution to delegate settlement authority
  authorized under the City Council Resolution No. 25-53A was approved by the
  Committee.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 10:42 a.m.
Adjournment
